text:
It's serviceable but not strong. "For those who don't know me" and "I have the receipts" are both stock toast phrasing, so nothing in the line sounds like you or Dave. It also makes a promise (embarrassing stories) that the rest of the toast has to pay off, and it needs a laugh line before that.

The easiest fix is specificity. Replace "the longest" with the actual number and a concrete detail: "I've known Dave for 23 years, since he tried to trade me a Pokémon card for my lunch. I still have the receipts." Specifics get laughs where general claims don't.

Also check that "the longest" is true. If a sibling or cousin is in the room, someone will heckle it.
